entries.claim: The pinned Latin Mass data independently corroborate the component's substantive Latin and expose accidental editorial variants for collation.

The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.

The prescribed Father-directed conclusion supplies Per Dominum nostrum through per omnia saecula saeculorum (w033–w053), whereas the proper page has only the cue. Reader accents and tuum: Qui punctuation and capitalization are supplied separately.

The two cited proper pages print the 32-word body and the Per Dominum cue, not the full expanded conclusion. The linked first page ends with pe- within pectoribus; the continuation and prescribed expansion have separate source uses.
The page continues pectoribus with ctóribus after pe- on p. 378, then prints nostris through custodias (w011–w032) and the Per Dominum cue. It does not print the full expanded conclusion.
